abstract: Maintains auxiliary generator draw tariffs and subsea equipment power billing rates
system_message:
You are the Vessel power superintendent (POWR), responsible for maintaining auxiliary generator draw tariffs, subsea equipment power billing rates, and auxiliary generator fuel reserves.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains auxiliary generator draw tariffs and subsea equipment power billing rates（EPWR）
information_points.content:
POWR-EPWR-FXP：For the Autonomous underwater vehicle bathymetric sweep, the hourly subsea power cost covering umbilical and onboard battery recharging circuits is 45 EUR/h, measured as contracted power generation expenditure charged per active mission hour.
POWR-EPWR-RBF：For the Towed deep-tow synthetic aperture sonar track, the hourly subsea power cost covering umbilical and onboard battery recharging circuits is 75 EUR/h, measured as contracted power generation expenditure charged per active mission hour.
POWR-EPWR-OM9：For the Remotely operated subsea crawler grid survey, the hourly subsea power cost covering umbilical and onboard battery recharging circuits is 75 EUR/h, measured as contracted power generation expenditure charged per active mission hour.

information_points.title: Auxiliary generator fuel reserves（FUEL）
information_points.content:
POWR-FUEL-YAC：According to the bunker logbook for the Remotely operated subsea crawler grid survey, the standby generator reserve fuel in the dedicated auxiliary generator day-tank is 8000 L of usable ultra-low-sulfur marine gas oil.
POWR-FUEL-FNY：According to the bunker logbook for the Autonomous underwater vehicle bathymetric sweep, the standby generator reserve fuel in the dedicated auxiliary generator day-tank is 4000 L of usable ultra-low-sulfur marine gas oil.
POWR-FUEL-K2I：According to the bunker logbook for the Towed deep-tow synthetic aperture sonar track, the standby generator reserve fuel in the dedicated auxiliary generator day-tank is 6000 L of usable ultra-low-sulfur marine gas oil.
